title: "CA - BF[2] Factor Structure"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(mosaic)
library(car)
```


```{r}
garlic <- read_csv("../data/garlic_bulb_mass.csv")
View(garlic)
```

```{r}
favstats(garlic$bulb_mass_g)
boxplot(bulb_mass_g ~ variety, data = garlic)
stripchart(bulb_mass_g ~ variety, data = garlic)
boxplot(bulb_mass_g ~ sun_exposure, data = garlic)
stripchart(bulb_mass_g ~ sun_exposure, data = garlic)
```

```{r}
interaction.plot(garlic$variety, garlic$sun_exposure, garlic$bulb_mass_g)
```

```{r}
gar1aov <- aov(bulb_mass_g ~ variety, data = garlic)
summary(gar1aov)
gar2aov<- aov(bulb_mass_g ~ sun_exposure, data = garlic)
summary(gar2aov)
```

```{r}
myaov <- aov(bulb_mass_g ~ variety + sun_exposure variety:sun_exposure, data = garlic)
myaov2 <- aov(bulb_mass_g ~ variety * sun_exposure, data = garlic)
legeneTest(myaov2)
```


```{r}
favstats(bulb_mass_g ~ variety + sun_exposure, data = garlic)
```
```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,3))
plot(gar1aov, which = 1)
plot(gar1aov, which = 2)
qqPlot(gar1aov$residuals)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,3))
plot(gar2aov, which = 1)
plot(gar2aov, which = 2)
qqPlot(gar2aov$residuals)
```




```{r}
wear <- read_csv("../data/wear.csv")
View(wear)
wear$prop <- factor(wear$prop)
wear$filler <- factor(wear$filler)
```

```{r}
favstats(wear$wear3)
boxplot(wear3 ~ prop, data = wear)
stripchart(wear3 ~ prop, data = wear)
boxplot(wear3 ~ filler, data = wear)
stripchart(wear3 ~ filler, data = wear)
```

```{r}
interaction.plot(wear$prop, wear$filler, wear$wear3)
```

```{r}
wear1aov <- aov(wear3 ~ prop, data = wear)
summary(wear1aov)
wear2aov<- aov(wear3 ~ filler, data = wear)
summary(wear2aov)
```

```{r}
BF2wear <- aov(wear3 ~ prop * filler, data = wear)
leveneTest(wear3 ~ interaction(prop, filler), data = wear)
summary(BF2wear2)
```




```{r}
p <- read_csv("../data/programmers.csv")
View(p)
```

```{r}
favstats(p$wear3)
boxplot(TimePredE ~ YearsOfExp, data = p)
stripchart(TimePredE ~ YearsOfExp, data = p)
boxplot(TimePredE ~ LgSysEx, data = p)
stripchart(TimePredE ~ LgSysEx, data = p)
```

```{r}
interaction.plot(p$YearsOfExp, p$LgSysEx, p$TimePredE)
```

```{r}
p1aov <- aov(TimePredE ~ YearsOfExp, data = p)
summary(p1aov)
p2aov<- aov(TimePredE ~ LgSysEx, data = p)
summary(p2aov)
```

```{r}
BF2p <- aov(TimePredE ~ YearsOfExp * LgSysEx, data = p)
leveneTest(TimePredE ~ interaction(YearsOfExp, LgSysEx), data = p)
summary(BF2p)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1,3))
plot(BF2p, which = 1)
plot(BF2p, which = 2)
qqPlot(BF2p$residuals)
```
